title: Payment Event
description:
Note: Inbound wire transfers are coming soon (availability varies by partner bank). Wire-related fields below are a preview. To learn more, contact your customer success manager.

Payment Event

amount.description: Amount of the financial event that has been settled in the currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents).

created.description: Date and time when the financial event occurred. UTC time zone.

detailed_results.description: More detailed reasons for the event

result.description: APPROVED financial events were successful while DECLINED financial events were declined by user, Lithic, or the network.

external_id.description:
Payment event external ID. For ACH transactions, this is the ACH trace number.
For inbound wire transfers, this is the IMAD (Input Message Accountability Data).
